parsedVerdict.reasoning: PlaceOrderUseCase is the kind of coordinating code an application layer should hold. Its execute() method checks the incoming request, builds domain objects (OrderLine, Order) and asks the domain StockReservationService to reserve stock. It then saves the order through the OrderRepository port and returns a DTO built by toOrderDto. The file contains no persistence code, transport handling (HTTP, controllers) or framework logic. The one check it does, that customerId is present, validates the request at the boundary; it isn't a domain invariant. Business rules about orders and stock stay in the domain types it calls. No ADR text was given to check against.
